title: Tailwind CSS Practical Tips
summary: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework. This article shares practical Tailwind CSS tips and best practices.

# Tailwind CSS Practical Tips Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that provides a large set of atomic classes, allowing you to build styles directly in HTML. ## Why Choose Tailwind - **High Development Efficiency** — No need to switch between HTML and CSS - **Consistency** — Unified naming conventions prevent style chaos - **Maintainability** — Delete unused classes to clean up styles - **Responsive** — Built-in responsive utility classes ## Practical Tips ### 1.
